comparison.objective: Egg task reorients and packs two fragile ovoids small-end-down; candidate commissions and locks an adjustable industrial damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Egg task tests shape-based end recognition, gentle grasping, transport reorientation, and release into tapered cups. Candidate tests hex-key engagement, counterholding, fine rotary adjustment, bounded tightening, and iterative physical cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Egg success requires each egg centered within 4 mm, below its cup rim, small end within 20° downward, released and stable. Candidate requires two safe repeatable stops under energy, velocity, stroke, rebound, overload, and lock-drift constraints.
comparison.reason: The tasks share only generic grasp-and-place primitives and test meaningfully different abilities. Missing rubric details: the egg record has no separate spec version but its body supplies objective and scoring; candidate rebound, overload, and drift thresholds remain unspecified.
